questionEnglish: Which part of the human eye controls the amount of light entering the eye?
questionOdia: ମାନବ ଚକ୍ଷୁର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶ ଆଖିକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରୁଥିବା ଆଲୋକର ପରିମାଣକୁ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିଥାଏ?
explanation: The iris is a dark muscular diaphragm that controls the size of the pupil, which in turn regulates the amount of light entering the eye.

questionEnglish: On which part of the human eye is the image of an object formed?
questionOdia: ମାନବ ଚକ୍ଷୁର କେଉଁ ଅଂଶରେ ବସ୍ତୁର ପ୍ରତିବିମ୍ବ ଗଠିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: The retina acts as a light-sensitive screen at the back of the eye where a real and inverted image of the object is formed.

questionEnglish: The ability of the eye lens to adjust its focal length is called?
questionOdia: ଚକ୍ଷୁ ଲେନ୍ସର ଫୋକସ୍ ଦୂରତାକୁ ସମାୟୋଜନ କରିବାର ଦକ୍ଷତାକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: The ability of the eye lens to adjust its focal length with the help of ciliary muscles to see both nearby and distant objects clearly is called accommodation.

questionEnglish: What is the least distance of distinct vision for a young adult with normal vision?
questionOdia: ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଶକ୍ତି ସମ୍ପନ୍ନ ଜଣେ ସୁସ୍ଥ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ପାଇଁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଦର୍ଶନର ସ୍ବଳ୍ପତମ ଦୂରତା କେତେ?
explanation: The minimum distance at which objects can be seen most distinctly without strain for a normal eye is exactly 25 cm.

questionEnglish: Which defect of vision is also known as near-sightedness?
questionOdia: କେଉଁ ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ଦୋଷକୁ ସମୀପ ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ଦୋଷ (Near-sightedness) ବୋଲି ମଧ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Myopia is a defect in which a person can see nearby objects clearly but cannot see distant objects distinctly.

questionEnglish: Which type of lens is used to correct hypermetropia (far-sightedness)?
questionOdia: ଦୂର ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ଦୋଷ (Hypermetropia) ର ସଂଶୋଧନ ପାଇଁ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ଲେନ୍ସ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ?
explanation: A convex lens of appropriate power provides additional converging power to focus the light rays exactly onto the retina, correcting hypermetropia.

questionEnglish: The splitting of white light into its component colors when passing through a prism is called?
questionOdia: ଏକ ପ୍ରିଜମ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଗତି କଲାବେଳେ ଶ୍ଵେତ ଆଲୋକର ସପ୍ତରଙ୍ଗରେ ବିଭାଜିତ ହେବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ କଣ କୁହାଯାଏ?
explanation: Dispersion is the phenomenon of splitting of a beam of white light into its seven constituent colors when it passes through a refracting medium like a glass prism.

questionEnglish: Which color of white light bends the most when passing through a glass prism?
questionOdia: କାଚ ପ୍ରିଜମ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଗତି କଲାବେଳେ ଶ୍ଵେତ ଆଲୋକର କେଉଁ ରଙ୍ଗ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ବିଚ୍ୟୁତ (Bends) ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: Violet light has the shortest wavelength and slows down the most in glass, causing it to bend or refract the most, while red light bends the least.

questionEnglish: The twinkling of stars is due to which atmospheric phenomenon?
questionOdia: ତାରାଗୁଡ଼ିକର ମିଟିମିଟି କରି ଚମକିବା କେଉଁ ବାୟୁମଣ୍ଡଳୀୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଯୋଗୁଁ ହୋଇଥାଏ?
explanation: The twinkling of a star is due to atmospheric refraction of starlight as it passes through layers of air with continuously varying refractive indices.

questionEnglish: Why does the clear sky appear blue during a bright sunny day?
questionOdia: ନିର୍ମଳ ଆକାଶର ରଙ୍ଗ ନୀଳ ଦେଖାଯିବାର କାରଣ କଣ?
explanation: The molecules of air and other fine particles in the atmosphere scatter shorter wavelengths of light (blue and violet) more strongly than longer wavelengths (red), making the sky appear blue.
